The activities included in this book are carefully selected to suit the developmental stage of young children. By engaging with difference puzzles and various other playful activities, children learn to focus, enhance their visual discrimination skills, and improve their ability to observe the world around them. This hands-on approach ensures that learning is not just absorbed passively but is actively experienced through enjoyable play. ## Perfect for Early Learners

This book serves as an excellent tool for developing pre-literacy skills, enhancing vocabulary through visual cues, and boosting concentration.
